integrity: The exact density and strict unimodality are established analytically; numerical diagnostics check but do not certify the proof.
scientific_limitations: Planar Euclidean triangles from independent uniform unoriented side directions, scale fixed by a predesignated unit side; neither fixed circumradius nor area-uniform point model. Historical priority provisional due to two inaccessible full texts; no independent validation.
title: An elementary inradius density and a parabolic rare-shape law for unit-base random-direction triangles
